scope: Local, user-initiated OpenPGP operations only; no network or unattended decryption oracle
justification: The RustSec advisory states that local use on a non-compromised computer is an accepted workaround and recommends avoiding attacker-observable timing. Addressee exposes no network decryption service. RSA public-key generation, import, encryption, signing, and verification remain available; private-key decryption is local-only and the unresolved upstream risk remains documented.
review: Reevaluate on every rsa or rPGP change and before adding any network, background automation, or batch-decryption interface.

scope: Build-time UniFFI binding generation through Askama; not part of the application runtime
justification: This is an unmaintained-package warning, not a reported vulnerability. The dependency is reached only through UniFFI binding-generation templates and processes trusted repository configuration. No runtime input is accepted by this component.
review: Remove when UniFFI or Askama provides a maintained dependency path, and reevaluate on every binding-tool change.
